title: Parallax Layers
description: Procedural ridgelines stacked from horizon to foreground, each drifting at its own speed so the scene reads with real depth — far layers pale, hazy and slow, near layers dark and racing. A sun/moon disc and a scatter of twinkling stars sit behind it all, and moving the pointer swings the whole stack for a hand-held parallax. Every ridge is generated from fractal value-noise, so nothing repeats. Layers, drift speed, parallax depth, ruggedness, atmosphere, palette (Dusk / Forest / Mono / Vapor / Ember), sun height and size, and star density are live params; the pointer drives the look and beats give the light a gentle bob.
